paper_source_conflicts: The case text calls FINO3 the reference wind farm although FINO3 is an offshore research platform and the study is framed as onshore.
The printed A-weighting equation uses natural-log typography although the acoustic-level equations and physical decibel definition require base-10 logarithms.
completion_decisions: Retain the target contribution as traditional PSO applied to both strict-noise and economic-compensation layout problems.
Digitize the 80 Figure-4 coordinate markers using the plotted axes and clamp plot-resolution boundary overshoots to the Table-1 construction region.
Digitize the 12 Figure-5 direction totals, retain five published speed bands through their midpoints and normalize the resulting 60 states.
Quantize the 500 m square observation zone on a deterministic 5 by 5 grid because m is unpublished.
Retain the two Hubbard fourth/fifth blade-speed mechanisms, octave A weighting and logarithmic source superposition through a dimensionally consistent spectrum completion.
Calibrate only the unavailable additive acoustic constants to the published 48.60 dBA reference-layout anchor.
Calibrate only the unavailable wind-series mass to the published 4015.17 GWh reference-layout anchor.
Use Ct=0.8, lambda-opt=7.5 and rated rotor speed 9.6 rpm with the published DTU 10 MW cut-in/rated/cut-out and rotor dimensions.
Use population 100, c1=c2=2, a 10-percent velocity bound and reference-centred normal initialization.
Use deterministic iterative 4D spacing repair in addition to the target penalty because feasible initialization and repair are unpublished.
Use 1000000 as the declared finite close-to-infinity coefficient for strict noise and spacing violations.

Complete the paper's unquantified limited slight-noise range with the 50 dBA upper value of its stated 45--50 dBA recommended range: compensation begins above 45 dBA and the economic case is infeasible above 50 dBA.
Do not implement IA-PSO because it is an unchanged time-only comparison baseline rather than the target contribution.

roles: Case A strict noise control: maximize annual energy with maximum observation-zone L10 at most 45 dBA and minimum spacing 4D
Case B economic compensation: maximize annual energy less 10000 kWh per dBA of excess observation-zone L10, with minimum spacing 4D
